text:
Predicates:
Loan(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Club(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ Loan(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ PlaysFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton is a football player who plays for Nautico.
PlaysFor(nautico, nautico) ∧ PlaysFor(braga, braga) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
Club(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬Loan(ailton, club) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
